tokens.v: Catch her mid-pivot with the can held high and loose, condensation flicking off it in an arc of droplets that carries the motion while she and the can stay sharp. 35mm at f/4 from waist height, tilted up so she breaks the top edge, hard light cutting her shadow long across the ground through the bottom-left corner. Boxy cream tee tucked into straight indigo denim, white leather sneakers, fully dressed. The pale-yellow body and green stripe read clean against the saturated field; FERRO & SONS sits small in the stripe, specular breaking across it. Her trailing hand blurs through the right edge.
